objective: Implement the smallest Phase 6C vertical slice: an InferencePage containing the required input controls and deterministic widget-to-InferenceRequest mapping, without starting inference or integrating MainWindow.
acceptance_criteria: src/image_ai_studio/gui/inference_page.py defines an InferencePage QWidget that can be constructed with an optional injected InferenceController without creating a QThread, QtInferenceWorker, or starting inference.
The page exposes controls for training output directory, model JSON, input image, device, and precision, plus a Run Inference button and an initial Idle status display.
Building a request derives state_dict_path as <training_output_dir>/best_model_state_dict.pt and class_mapping_path as <training_output_dir>/class_mapping.json.
The request is created through the existing build_inference_request public API and preserves the selected model JSON path, image path, device, and precision.
No Phase 6B inference core, controller, or worker public interface is changed.
Tests verify initial widget state, fixed artifact path derivation, and widget-to-request mapping using qtbot and a fake or injected controller; no real model inference is performed.
Automated visual or screenshot verification is not part of this checkpoint; widget properties, labels, enabled state, and request values are the substitute verification.
claude_prompt: Implement only Phase 6C checkpoint 1. Add src/image_ai_studio/gui/inference_page.py and tests/gui/test_inference_page.py. Follow TrainingPage's direct QWidget composition and _build_request pattern, but do not copy training-only lifecycle or introduce a generic ViewModel/base page abstraction. The page must provide training output directory, model JSON, image, device, and precision inputs. Derive best_model_state_dict.pt and class_mapping.json from the selected training output directory and create requests only through image_ai_studio.application.inference_controller.build_inference_request. Support optional InferenceController injection for later lifecycle work and tests. Do not create or start QThread/QtInferenceWorker, run inference, modify MainWindow, implement result lifecycle, add image preview, or alter Phase 6B public APIs. Add focused qtbot tests for initial state, artifact path derivation, and exact widget-to-request mapping. Visual screenshot testing is unavailable, so verify visible labels, control state, and mapped request values programmatically.
estimated_scope: Small: one new GUI module and one focused GUI test module, approximately 150-250 lines combined.
